title: Maps and Timetables
text:
A map shows you where places are. It has lines for roads and small pictures for parks and schools. Maps help you find your way in a new city. Look at the map before you walk.

A timetable shows when buses and trains leave and arrive. The times are in rows and columns. Ana looks at the timetable at the station. The train leaves at nine o'clock.

questions.text: What does a map show you?
What shows when buses and trains leave?
Why is a map helpful when you visit a new city?
options: It helps you find your way

questions.text: Why does Ana look at the timetable?
options: To see when the train leaves

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows where places are
a list that shows when buses or trains leave and arrive
a place where trains or buses stop so people can get on and off

paragraph_translations: Un mapa te muestra dónde están los lugares. Tiene líneas para las carreteras y pequeños dibujos para los parques y las escuelas. Los mapas te ayudan a encontrar el camino en una ciudad nueva. Mira el mapa antes de caminar.
Un horario muestra cuándo salen y llegan los autobuses y los trenes. Las horas están en filas y columnas. Ana mira el horario en la estación. El tren sale a las nueve en punto.
